ownerInstruction: Prepare version 1.1.1 and upload it for App Store submission only after version 1.1 is approved.
scope: The previously presented marketing/ASO package, matching version/build settings, truthful localized release notes, and review notes. Watch ships with iOS.

deferredActions.gate: Freshly verify predecessor 1.1 approval for every platform included in an upload; submit only when Apple allows the next version.

constraints: Do not upload, apply listing changes, or submit 1.1.1 before its predecessor approval gate is met.
Recheck live App Store status; this saved snapshot is not proof of later approval.

Apple requires the current version to be Ready for Distribution before creating a new App Store version. Mac and Vision 1.1 are manual releases; approval alone can leave them Pending Developer Release.
Do not withdraw or replace the 1.1 reviews or silently change their release settings.
No 1.1 manual-release action is authorized by this preparation alone; handle any pending manual release explicitly before submitting 1.1.1.
The upload helper handles configured platforms together. If only some predecessors are approved, do not accidentally upload unapproved platforms.
Upload archives may receive tool-assigned build numbers; verify actual uploaded version, build, encryption answer, and processing status before attachment.
Retain approved existing screenshots, previews, search artwork, headers, purchases, prices, availability, and privacy settings.
No custom analytics service, additional dependency, or runtime feature changes are included.
Keep lock.json tool-managed; never hand-edit sync state or bypass a conflict.
Do not submit the old 1.1 build as 1.1.1 or invent a feature changelog.

monitoring.explanation: This is committed release preparation and a conditional authorization record, not a scheduled monitoring job.
